messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up — opened a Terraform PR to tweak the inference pool autoscaling + secret binding. Can someone sanity-check before I merge? PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4821 :wave:

alex: grabbing it now. TL;DR of changes? autoscale ranges, any new annotations, and vault path changes?

elaine: Yep — summary: HPA min replicas 2 -> 4, max 50 -> 100, target CPU 65 -> 60. Add an annotation on the provisioner for short-term surge window and a small buffer PodDisruptionBudget change. Also changed the Karpenter auth secret to read from Vault path `secret/data/infra/karpenter` instead of the old AWS SSM param store binding.

matt: Why bump HPA min to 4? Are we seeing pod startup latency that makes 2 insufficient for steady CPU spikes?

elaine: We observed tail latencies during 10–15 minute batch windows where pods take ~45s to warm up (large model cold start). Doubling min gives headroom for those short bursts and reduces throttling while Karpenter provisions. Intend to rely on Karpenter surge for the really short spikes.

julia: Looking at the secret change — Vault path is fine, but the PR needs the rotation webhook and the `vault:read` policy attached to the service role. I left a comment on the terraform module to add the policy and the rotation hook.

elaine: Added the policy in a followup commit, and linked the rotation webhook (hook url is internal). I put the snippet in the PR description.

alex: A couple quick nits:
- add `minReadySeconds: 30` to the deployment so new pods don't flip alive right away
- PDB: set `maxUnavailable: 1` not a percentage (we want deterministic behavior)
- ensure HPA behavior under OOMs is OK (scale-down stabilization 5m?)

elaine: Good calls — will update. On stabilization: currently scaleDown.stabilizationWindowSeconds = 300 in the HPA manifest, keeping that.

matt: Also, consider adding `maxSurge: 2` on the provisioner rollout (or equivalent) so we don't overshoot cluster capacity when Karpenter requests nodes. Curious if we should lower eviction pressure by setting pod `tolerations` for `node.kubernetes.io/not-ready` for short windows.

elaine: Noted. I'll add `maxSurge: 2` and a short toleration for `node.kubernetes.io/unreachable` with tolerationSeconds=60.

sre-bot: terraform plan completed for branch autofix/autoscale-4821 — no IAM drift detected. New Vault policy `kv-read-infra-karpenter` will be created. Planned resources: +3, ~1 unchanged.

elaine: thanks @sre-bot. @sre-oncall can you do a quick read for rollout risk? want to schedule a small canary for the inference pool later today.

sre-oncall: quick skim — main risk is hitting Provisioner startup quota in us-west-2 during the canary. Recommend scheduling canary at low-traffic hour and enabling the `fallback-pool` routing so traffic lands on on-demand fallback for first 5 minutes if node provisioning lags. Also add a Prometheus alert for `karpenter_provisioner_unavailable_total > 0` during rollout window.

elaine: Will schedule canary 02:30 UTC and add fallback routing for first 5m. I'll also add the Prom alert as suggested.

julia: One more security check — the Vault path change requires the secrets-engine mount to have `max_ttl` configured or rotation will fail for long-lived tokens. I left a patch in the vault terraform module.

ops-bot: apply window scheduled: 1749994500 (in ~3 minutes). Canary window: 5m. Rollout policy: canary=10%, fallback-route=enabled.

alex: LGTM from infra side pending the two small HPA/Deployment tweaks from my comments. If you want I can do a quick approve on the PR after you push the updates.

elaine: Pushed updates for `minReadySeconds`, PDB `maxUnavailable: 1`, `maxSurge: 2`, and Vault policy patch. PTAL @alex @julia. Thanks all :raised_hands:

matt: +1 for merge after one more CI run.

ops-bot: CI passed (unit + terratest). Ready to merge.

elaine: merging now. will monitor the canary dashboard and post results here in 10m. :bar_chart:
